question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**recurred**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the wetter periods in North Africa that occur regularly.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate something that happens repeatedly or cyclically.
 
• "**Recurred**" fits well as it denotes happening again periodically, which aligns with the context of the passage.
 
• Other options ("**seized**", "**terminated**", "**abated**") do not fit the context of regularly occurring wetter periods.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The fact that the wetter periods in North Africa have recurred__ every 21,000 years or so is a big clue about what ________2_________ them: variations in Earth’s orbit. Due to gravitational influences from the moon and other planets in our solar system, the orbit of the Earth _________3___________ the sun is not constant. It has cyclic ______4_______ on multi-thousand year timescales. These orbital cycles _______5_______ the amount of energy the Earth receives from the sun. On 100,000-year cycles, the shape of Earth’s orbit shifts between circular and oval.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Seized (कब्जा करना): "Seized" means to take hold of suddenly or forcibly, which does not fit the context of cyclic wetter periods.
 
• Terminated (समाप्त करना): "Terminated" means brought to an end, which does not reflect the ongoing recurrence of wetter periods.
 
• Abated (कम होना): "Abated" means to become less intense, which does not align with the idea of periodic occurrences.
